reviewPointAdded.title: Missing [DisableConcurrentExecution]
reviewPointAdded.summary: AiInvocation doesn't use [DisableConcurrentExecution], unlike 3 of 3 classes that take PiiGateway in this repository.
reviewPointAdded.whyItMatters: Most classes that take PiiGateway here use [DisableConcurrentExecution] — for example CatchMeUpProcessor, MessageIntelligenceProcessor and SuggestedNextActionProcessor. Following the established approach keeps behaviour predictable for callers and makes the code easier to reason about alongside its peers. No existing peer deviates from this, so a difference here is worth confirming.
reviewPointAdded.suggestedComment: Other classes that take PiiGateway in this repo (CatchMeUpProcessor, MessageIntelligenceProcessor and SuggestedNextActionProcessor) use [DisableConcurrentExecution]. Should AiInvocation follow the same approach, or is the difference intentional here?
